subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Zephyr's demand
fact: Two gold coins are demanded for sparing the commander's life.
source_quote: Two gold coins for sparing your life, please.

subject: gold coin value
fact: Two gold pieces are handed over as a symbol of surrender, not payment.
source_quote: The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything.

subject: Zephyr's declaration
fact: Zephyr claims respect, not money, as the true currency of submission.
source_quote: What I demand is not money, but respect.

subject: Calmer's assertion
fact: Calmer declares himself Chief Cleric and supreme authority of the Upper Temple.
source_quote: the Obsidian Edge and the Chief Cleric is myself, Calmer.

subject: Water Temple altar
fact: The Water Temple altar holds a drowned fortune of coins, gems, and seashells.
source_quote: And in that water, gentlemen, coins. Gems. Seashells. A whole drowned fortune sitting there waiting.

subject: gargoyle threat
fact: Four stone gargoyles animate and attack when the bronze bas-relief is touched.
source_quote: the gargoyles came off their pillars. Wings unfolding. Stone going from stone to intent.

subject: Calmer's spirit invocation
fact: Calmer summons radiant spirits that dismantle three gargoyles with ease.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits. They came the way they always come for me... the first gargoyle nearest the spirits simply ended.

subject: Zinnia's warning
fact: Zinnia warns Calmer not to overreach into a temple he does not yet own.
source_quote: not to go too deep. To not overreach into a room I did not yet own.

subject: Zephyr's leadership claim
fact: Zephyr declares himself and his group the new bosses of the temple hierarchy.
source_quote: We are the new bosses, so,

subject: commander's surrender
fact: The commander surrenders his position and allegiance after being overwhelmed by force and psychological pressure.
source_quote: You know, I never really liked Alrrem.

subject: Calmer's final authority
fact: Calmer asserts control over the Fire Temple by naming the surrendered cleric as head Cleric.
